verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway supports authentication/authorization plugins (JWT, OAuth, ACLs) and Vaults for secret storage, plus MCP traffic governance/security features that could be used to scope agent access, and Konnect Dev Portal lets users manage their own credentials. However, there's no explicit documentation of issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials specifically for AI agents (e.g., per-agent API keys with fine-grained permission scopes tied to MCP tool access). missing for 10: dedicated agent-credential-issuance workflow, explicit least-privilege scoping model for agents, hands-on validation of scoped credential issuance for an agent identity.
